_doc: How kcc-run invokes each harness, as data. Nothing in the drivers assumes a harness: they read the active harness's row here, and the model of each tier from kernel/models.json (settings run.registry picks another column, for example 'ollama' behind the opencode harness). Placeholders: {agent} {model} {effort} {skill}. Empty means the harness has no such option, and the driver leaves it out: no agent flag means a worker state runs under one orchestrator session instead of directly as the agent; no effort flag means the effort is not passed. insert_after is the token of the start template after which the flags go (continuity.start.<harness>). effort_map folds the neutral ladder low..max onto what the harness accepts. A project overrides any key with settings.json -> harness_invoke.<harness>.<key>.
